basics.name: Sudhakar Reddy Peddinti
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and scaling high-performance Java/Spring Boot microservices and real-time/batch data pipelines at a top-3 global retailer. Expert in distributed backend architectures, stream processing (Spark Streaming, Kafka), workload automation (Control-M), and enterprise data warehousing (Azure Synapse Analytics). Specialist in polyglot data layers (PostgreSQL, Cassandra, CosmosDB, Elasticsearch), high-concurrency caching strategies, and zero-downtime database migrations. Proven track record of translating complex product requirements into resilient, highly available systems that drive business impact.

work.name: Walmart
work.summary: Lead architectural strategy for core backend microservices and high-throughput data synchronization pipelines powering search ranking, faceted navigation, and merchandising rules for 10+ global markets. Own cross-team API contracts, system integration roadmaps, and large-scale data architecture migrations.
highlights: Architected a zero-downtime data layer migration for the Item-Pinning microservice, designing tenant-aware DAOs with dual-write synchronization across AzureSQL and GCP PostgreSQL to seamlessly onboard 5 global markets without service interruption.

Engineered an automated Facet Lifecycle Management backend powered by a custom state machine, managing 82,000+ business curations backed by CosmosDB and Elasticsearch with self-healing reconciliation.

Designed a high-scale analytics pipeline integrating Azure Synapse Analytics and Control-M to ingest and analyze multi-terabyte user interaction datasets, translating raw telemetry into real-time merchandising adjustments.

Designed a resilient, near-real-time synchronization pipeline using Spark Streaming and Kafka, implementing idempotent message processing and Cassandra TTL contracts to eliminate stale-data race conditions for 100M+ items.

Spearheaded performance tuning and modernization of core Java microservices, upgrading to Spring Boot 3, implementing automated secret rotation, and standardizing Kubernetes resources to improve throughput by 15% and resolve critical CVEs.

work.name: Walmart
work.summary: Owned technical design, data-model migrations, and real-time streaming architectures for core rules-management and experiment-evaluation backend microservices.
highlights: Engineered a versioned NoSQL data model for the core rules engine, executing a zero-downtime, 4-phase migration of 58,000+ complex business rules using feature flags and automated validation gates.

Built the Affinity Override Java microservice from the ground up, implementing high-performance caching and asynchronous Azure Blob Storage integrations to support high-throughput bulk data ingestion.

Architected event-driven A/B testing and interleaving experiment infrastructure for search-ranking rules, implementing combinatorial safeguards and real-time Kafka notifications to validate search algorithms at scale.

Led zero-downtime database migrations from AzureSQL to GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), establishing highly available distributed cache clusters and optimizing connection pool configurations to support 15,000+ queries/second.
Deconstructed a legacy monolithic application into independent Java microservices, extracting the Category Intervention service to improve deployment velocity and isolate compute resources.

Designed and deployed a Spark Streaming data pipeline to synchronize product catalog updates with Elasticsearch and Cassandra cache layers, reducing catalog synchronization lag from 4 hours to under 30 seconds.

key_differentiators.summary: Why hire me as a Staff Backend & Data Systems Engineer

points.detail: I design and scale highly available Java/Spring Boot microservices powering global-scale e-commerce functionality. By building resilient APIs, implementing caching abstractions, and enforcing contract-driven development, I ensure robust, low-latency, and decoupled backend architectures.

I architect robust data synchronization and processing pipelines using Spark Streaming, Control-M, and Kafka. By integrating Azure Synapse Analytics, I bridge operational transactions with analytics environments, translating massive telemetry datasets into actionable business outcomes.

I specialize in zero-downtime migrations of high-volume relational and NoSQL datastores (AzureSQL, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, Cassandra). Using dual-write patterns, feature flags, and automated validation gates, I migrate live production traffic with absolute safety.
